stem: Feroz compares two class teams. Team A has $5$ players and scored $45$ goals in all. Team B has $9$ players and scored $63$ goals in all. He wants a fair comparison of typical scoring when the teams have different sizes.

parts.text: Which claim chooses a fair representative basis?

options.text: Use the totals $45$ and $63$ only, and say Team B is ahead because $63$ is larger.
Compare goals per player ($9$ versus $7$), because the teams have different sizes.
Say Team A is ahead because $5$ is smaller than $9$, using team size alone as the score.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The teams have different sizes, so goals per player is a fairer basis than totals or team size alone.

teacher.key_rationale: With unequal group sizes, compare per player (45/5=9 vs 63/9=7). Totals alone or team size alone are not a fair typical-score basis.
